metadata.description: Fixed-price EHS consulting for regulated companies in Switzerland.

landing.title: Senior experts. No slides. Just results.
landing.lead: A benchmarked risk profile, a ranked shortlist of senior experts and a fixed-price proposal, before you commit.

price.title: Fixed price.
price.body: No negotiation, no surprises on the invoice.

kickoff.title: Kick off the same week.

app.title: Client area
app.body: The dashboard for client companies grows here.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.description: Your assessments, KPIs and programs appear here once the first features are switched on.

expert.title: Expert area
expert.body: The workspace for EHS experts grows here.

empty.title: No assignments yet
empty.description: Assigned reviews and reports appear here once the first client companies are on board.

admin.title: Ops admin
admin.body: Internal area for the operations team.

scaffold.heading: Check the scaffold
scaffold.intro: These actions prove that background jobs, error monitoring and analytics are wired up.
scaffold.empty: No runs yet. Run a background task.

gallery.title: Design gallery
gallery.description: Every primitive in every state. This is where keyboard, focus, screen reader and contrast are checked in light and dark.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Mark, lockups, palette and the campaign language: statement with the square stop, inverse block and signature.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: The campaign format as marketing blocks: one object on white, statement with the square stop, subline, signature. Pair, contrast, four panel strip, type only piece and the wall.

tokens.title: Color and contrast
tokens.description: Every guaranteed color pair with its contrast ratio measured live in the active theme.

type.title: Type
type.description: Geist in five roles (display, headline, subhead, body, caption), Geist Mono for identifiers, tabular figures for numbers.

buttons.title: Buttons and badges
buttons.description: Every variant and size, with icon, disabled, plus status and severity badges.

forms.title: Forms
forms.description: React Hook Form with Zod. Errors sit under the field and are linked to it.

formatting.title: Formats
formatting.description: The named number and date formats, live through the request formatter: CHF, percentages and dates read the Swiss way in both languages.

table.title: Tables
table.description: Default and compact density. Only table cells may truncate, and only with the full text in a tooltip.

overlays.title: Overlays
overlays.description: Dialog, sheet, menu, popover and tooltip. Focus is trapped and returned.

feedback.title: Feedback and structure
feedback.description: Alerts, progress, separator, breadcrumb, tabs, pagination and a card.

states.title: States
states.description: Loading, empty, error and toasts that every page reuses.

charts.title: Charts
charts.description: Recharts on the chart tokens. Tooltip and legend follow the theme.

research.title: Research
research.description: The progress list of a background run and the confidence badges of the KPI table (spec 0007).

brand.inverseText: Fixed price. No negotiation. Kick off the same week.
brand.inverseBody: Every component works on the jet ground because the block switches the tokens for its subtree.

rule.clearSpace: Clear space: 30 px on each side, at every reproduction size.
rule.minimum: Minimum size: 80 px wide, below that clarity is lost.
rule.noRecolor: Never recolor: black on white or white on jet/obsidian only.
rule.noEffects: No effects, shadows, rotation or distortion.
rule.noRedraw: Never redraw the wordmark; the asset kit file replaces the path in brand-mark.tsx.

welcome.subject: Welcome to SME24, {organizationName}
welcome.preview: Your account for {organizationName} is set up. The next step is the company lookup.
welcome.intro: Your account for {organizationName} is set up. SME24 builds a benchmarked EHS risk profile of your company from public disclosures and matches you with experienced experts, at a fixed price.
welcome.nextStep: The next step: sign in and start the company lookup. We research your figures in the background and get in touch once the profile is ready.

emails.title: Emails
emails.description: Every email SME24 has sent: the status from the send and the delivery, filters, search and a retry for failures.

empty.title: No emails yet

research.title: Your company
research.description: Enter your company. We research its public safety figures and show them with their sources.

lookup.title: Research your company
lookup.description: The name comes from your organization. A website helps us find the right reports.
lookup.name: Company name
lookup.nextBody: A background run searches sustainability, annual and safety reports, extracts eight KPIs for the latest three reporting years, and checks every value against its source.
lookup.durationNote: Takes a few minutes. You can keep the page open.
lookup.trustNote: Every value shows where it came from and how sure the system is.
